# Sync Requirements Checklist: Sync Feeds and Batch Upload (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 009 — batch upload parity with per-record writes, ordering and dependencies, feed positions and recovery, wallets gained and lost, the balance a person sees, and backend contract fidelity
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): data-loss and correctness risks of the switch (parity, order, recovery, purge), then contract fidelity; standard depth; audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec, plan or research in the same session; each says where. Unchecked items were reviewed and hold; they stay open for the PR reviewer.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is it specified what a run does with its reads when its upload found no connection? [Gap → fixed: FR-026 "A run whose upload found no connection MUST skip its reads and report offline"]
- [x] CHK002 Is the refresh outcome defined when a screen's read covers several scopes and only some complete? [Gap → fixed: FR-015 combination rule (spec 007 rule)]
- [x] CHK003 Is it specified whether a wallet whose own membership is merely absent from a full read of the person's scope is removed? [Gap → fixed: FR-011 last sentence, Edge Cases, research R-03, contract `WalletScopes.unconfirmed`]
- [x] CHK004 Is the order defined for a waiting transaction edited to use a category created later (queue order inverted)? [Gap → fixed: Edge Cases; R-07 hold for one run]
- [ ] CHK005 Are all syncable kinds the client stores mapped to a feed row type, and every whole-list read it replaces named? [Completeness, Spec §5 table, FR-001, FR-016]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the changes the batch cannot carry enumerated (archive, archive + edit, restore, ownership transfer)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK007 Are request-level answers of the upload each assigned an outcome (offline, timeout, 401, 426, 429, 5xx, envelope 422, 400, 404/405, 415, undecodable)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, §FR-021, contracts/sync-api-client.md]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the handling of each feed refusal (400 INVALID_CURSOR, 410, 404, 422 INVALID_ID, other 400s) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009, §FR-011, contracts/sync-api-client.md]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the app-wide signals raised by single writes (unverified address, plan limit) required for batch items too? [Completeness, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the adoption rule for kinds skipped now (C7–C9) written where those features will find it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, contracts/sync-engine-v2.md]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 Is "the same or newer version" unambiguous for wallet records re-sent with an unchanged version and a new balance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "a change that needs another record to exist first" defined by an explicit list (source wallet, destination, category)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "held" distinguished from "retried" (no try counted, no backoff)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, research R-07]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the moment a position is stored (after a page's rows are applied) stated precisely? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK015 Is it clear which rows a sweep may never remove (queued change, placeholder, unsettled carry)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, data-model §1]
- [x] CHK016 Are the refresh floors per trigger stated, rather than one floor for all? [Ambiguity → fixed: FR-014 keeps each trigger's spec 006–008 floor; research R-10]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK017 Does the 410 handling ("discard and re-read") stay consistent with the contract's "discard the scope's local data, keep queued writes" in its end state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008, Clarification 3]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the lost-wallet rule consistent with the spec 004 edge case "access to the record is lost" and the spec 006/008 removal path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Clarification 1]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the batch item bodies required to be identical to the per-record bodies, including the stored kind, destination and currency rules of specs 007–008? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, contracts/sync-engine-v2.md]
- [ ] CHK020 Do the success criteria on request counts (SC-001) agree with the per-record exceptions of FR-018? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the balance carry requirement consistent with spec 008 SC-004 and with per-wallet reads? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, research R-09]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 Can SC-003 ("downloads that change only") be verified on the host (row counts per read)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK023 Is SC-008 ("unchanged behaviour") bounded to named existing tests and their allowed edits? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK024 Does each user story's independent test name an observable result without a device? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §8, owner policy]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are recovery flows covered for process death during an upload and during a read? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec US5-S2, §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK026 Is first sync after the app update (no positions, existing data) specified? [Coverage, Spec US4-S4, §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK027 Are gained, lost, role-changed and never-accepted wallets each covered? [Coverage, Spec US3]
- [ ] CHK028 Is a clash inside a batch covered alongside accepted and refused items in the same request? [Coverage, Spec US1-S4, US1-S5]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 Is a transfer arriving on both feeds defined (stored once, versions only compared, no cross-feed order)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK030 Is a deleted-elsewhere record with a waiting change defined (stays until settled)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the person's own accepted deletion read back from a feed defined (hidden with its carry)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK032 Is a second INVALID_CURSOR in the same run bounded? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK033 Is a timed-out batch's resend allowed to produce a clash, and is that shown like any clash? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases, ADR-0016]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK034 Are logging rules stated for payloads, amounts, notes and cursor values? [Security, Spec §FR-030, P-09.2]
- [ ] CHK035 Is sign-out required to wipe positions with the queue and copies? [Security, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the answer allowance for an upload quantified (60 s) against the contract's minimum (30 s)? [Performance, Spec §FR-023, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the cost of a refresh with N followed wallets acknowledged (1 + N reads) with a decision? [Performance, Spec §9]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK038 Is the backend commit recorded, with each contract change since spec 008 mapped to an FR or a follow-up? [Dependency, Spec §5 "Contract changes since last spec"]
- [ ] CHK039 Are the uncommitted backend v1.9 edits identified as such, and is the client's handling independent of them landing? [Dependency, Spec §5, plan "External dependencies"]
- [ ] CHK040 Is "no periodic background read" recorded as a deliberate decision with its follow-up (C16)? [Assumption, Clarification 4, Assumptions]
